conditions: over 475 cal AND under 35g carb per serving; low-carb dinner; scalable to 14; no seafood
notes: All verified from source page with published per-serving nutrition clearing the gate (475+ cal, <35g carb). Catalog is saturated on ethnic chicken over rice/noodles and pasta bakes; open corner is starch-free creamy/cheesy skillets, cream braises, cheese bakes. Pricer exercise: unmapped ingredients flagged, not filtered.

candidates.name: Marry Me Chicken
ingredients_verbatim: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced lengthwise into thinner cutlets
3 large cloves garlic, minced or pressed
1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and chopped
candidates.why: Flagship low-carb cream skillet (sun-dried tomato + parmesan), 567 cal / 11g carb strong margin; all board ingredients; scales cleanly to 14. Only a pork 'marry me' exists in catalog.
